verdict.rationale: Intel's own docs list ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, DirectML, WindowsML, WebNN as supported AI frameworks for the CPU, and highlight oneDNN/PyTorch optimizations plus VTune profiling for Core Ultra CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, showing genuine vendor-stack and mainstream-runtime alignment. However, there's no explicit mention of llama.cpp or MLX support, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that these runtimes actually run well on this specific desktop SKU (which notably lacks an NPU, unlike mobile Core Ultra chips). Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp/GGML backend documentation, confirmation of NPU presence/support on this exact desktop part, and independent developer benchmarks validating local-AI runtime performance.
